translations.zh: 昭妃阿懶，海陵叔曹國王宗敏妻也。
translations.literal: Bright Consort A Lan was the wife of Hailing's uncle, Prince of Cao, Zongmin.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Consort A Lan was the wife of Hailing's uncle Zongmin, Prince of Cao.

translations.zh: 海陵殺宗敏而納阿懶宮中，貞元元年，封為昭妃。
translations.literal: Hailing killed Zongmin and took A Lan into the palace; in the first year of Zhenyuan she was enfeoffed as Bright Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing killed Zongmin and brought A Lan into the palace; in the first year of the Zhenyuan reign she was made Bright Consort.

translations.zh: 大臣奏「宗敏屬近尊行，不可」。
translations.literal: The ministers memorialized, "Zongmin belongs to a close and honored line of kin; this cannot be allowed."
translations.idiomatic: The ministers memorialized, "Zongmin is of close and honored kin; this cannot be allowed."

translations.literal: She was then ordered to leave the palace.
translations.idiomatic: She was then ordered to leave the palace.
